title: sarothamnus arboreus var. intermedius
intro: Sarothamnus arboreus var. intermedius, commonly known as intermediate broom, is a plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The health benefits of the plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of intermediate broom include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
